# Test fixtures

`paris-11-1037-704.pbf` - one vector tile (Mapbox Vector Tile, OpenMapTiles schema) covering Paris at zoom 11,
downloaded once from **OpenFreeMap** (`https://tiles.openfreemap.org/planet/…/11/1037/704.pbf`) to test the MVT
